podcast.title: Lesser Known New Wave Powerpop
podcast.body: The Quick is mentioned as one of the "lesser known bands" from the new wave era that adopted Powerpop's style. Their work demonstrates the genre's influence extending to a wider array of artists beyond the mainstream successes. "There were lesser known bands with names like The Rubinous and The Spungtones and The Quick and Great Buildings."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Lesser Known New Wave Powerpop
xref.body: Great Buildings are noted as one of the "lesser known bands" that fused new wave and Powerpop sensibilities. Their inclusion signifies the pervasive nature of the Powerpop sound in the late 1970s and early 1980s, even among less commercially successful acts. "There were lesser known bands with names like The Rubinous and The Spungtones and The Quick and Great Buildings."
